title: GameState (DRAFT bridge-draft-0)
description: DRAFT. Normalized game state sent every turn (D-003: board, card/slot state, other game info). The site worker's internal state has 156 top-level keys across the fixtures; this schema promotes a small core to named fields and carries EVERY other site key untouched in `extra`, so nothing is lost and the mapping is reversible (site state = extra + core fields, with winner null <-> empty string). Which `extra` keys a Rust engine must really model is an open question.

mode.description: Observed: "play" and "gameover". Other site modes were not in the fixtures, so this is not an enum.

actionsRemaining.description: Actions left in the current turn (free moves, extra moves). It is 1 in every fixture, so its real behaviour is unverified.

board.description: 8x8, board[row][col], null = empty. All 349 fixtures were 8x8.

captures.description: Captured pieces per side. Which side the key refers to (captor or victim) was not checked; verify before relying on it.

extra.description: All remaining site state keys, verbatim (rule flags, pending effects, per-card bookkeeping, recentMoves, ...). Opaque to the bridge.

CardSlot.description: A card in a side's deck slots. instanceId is unique per copy. `used` and `recovering` decide whether it can be played. Extra keys are allowed.

recovering.description: Missing on one card (submerge) in the fixtures, so optional.
